links.outcome: Model error rates when applied to clinical urine isolates after training on invasive isolates
links.effect: With six antibiotics as input, 84% of predictions correct; major error rate 19% and very major error rate 12%.
links.quote: Across all predictions generated using susceptibility results for six antibiotics as input, the major and very major error rates were 19% and 12%, respectively.

links.outcome: Performance versus EUCAST disk diffusion reference on clinical isolates
links.effect: 84% correct predictions; major and very major error rates of 19% and 12%; errors varied between antibiotics.
links.quote: Without conformal prediction, 84% of predictions were correct when susceptibility results of six antibiotics were used to predict susceptibility to eight additional antibiotics.

models_evaluated: AI-based decision support method trained on TESSy

links.effect: Conformal prediction reduced errors; abstentions were 9.6%, 14%, and 22% at 90%, 95%, and 97.5% confidence.
links.quote: Conformal prediction reduced errors but increased abstentions; at confidence levels of 90%, 95%, and 97.5%, the model abstained in 9.6%, 14%, and 22% of instances.

links.outcome: major and very major prediction errors

links.quote: Across all predictions generated using susceptibility results for six antibiotics as input, the major and very major error rates were 19% and 12%, respectively.
